description: Qwen-Image-2512 text-to-image. qwen_image clip, qwen_image_vae, AuraFlow sampling. Supports 50-step standard mode or 4-step Lightning LoRA fast mode. Supports structured JSON prompts and negative prompts.

prompt.description: Text or JSON prompt for image generation

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt — things to avoid in the image

enable_lightning.description: Enable 4-step Lightning LoRA for ultra-fast generation (4 steps, cfg=1 instead of 50 steps, cfg=4)

batch_size.description: Number of images to generate per batch
